recommendation: Carry all three topics to a bounded repair pass before publication: chapter 18-advancement ships only after (1) the raw-Typst block is closed and the fence gate is strengthened, (2) the Reveling benefit is restated as granted or earned with no price attached, (3) the carousing award gets a bound printed in the chapter and the advertised title eligibility is closed, and (4) the level 3/6/9 milestone label is renamed in both the chapter and its quick-reference mirror with a cross-reference added and the Archmage card's level requirement stated. No arithmetic is reopened, no reputation-scale mapping is invented, and no redesign of the reward section is entertained.
rationale: t-01: f-001 and f-002 located the commerce residue inside the Reveling mechanic itself and f-006 reported the whole chapter printing as Typst source; r-001 establishes both defects, confines the commerce repair to that one sentence, requires a clean-rebuild acceptance test for the fence, bars any reopening of the arithmetic, and hands the award-magnitude question to t-02 rather than closing it. t-02: f-003 priced the uncapped carousing point, f-005 showed the advertised standing-to-title eligibility has no implementer in the book, and f-009 could break neither while tightening the crossing to night fourteen; r-002 requires a bound that is printed in the chapter, requires the eligibility promise to be closed either by deletion or by a stated standing, and forbids inventing a mapping to the guide's separate faction scale. t-03: f-004 showed the milestone label is misnamed against the defining chapter and the glossary, f-007 showed the Archmage grant sets no level floor, and f-008's round-two challenge broke f-007's premise without reaching either defect; r-003 mandates a narrow in-place repair landing in two files with a cross-reference, keeps the card's tier floor, and rejects any redesign framing. Disposition classes follow f-010's tally: f-001, f-002, f-005, f-006, f-007 are chapter-local mechanical repairs, f-004 is mechanical but must be edited in a second file, and the true design questions are the bound on the carousing award and whether a granted card is held outright or lapses with its title. Librarian's own observation, not a council finding and not carried as a defect: the orchestrator's leads on hyphen ranges (18-advancement.qmd:40,78-81), the abbreviated table header at :77, the 'DP windfall' cell at :51 and the phrase 'skill rank' at :103 appear in no finding in the ledger, so this recommendation asserts nothing about them.

resolved.outcome: Two defects stand (f-001, f-002, f-006) and both are carried. MECHANICAL, chapter-local: append the missing closing fence to 18-advancement.qmd (the opener at :3 is the file's only fence marker, so the block runs to end of document at :107); accept the repair only on a clean rebuild that shows decorated section headings and both ladders as real tables, since the repository's existing gate does not evidence the block is sound (r-001 c3). MECHANICAL, one sentence: rewrite the Reveling sentence at 18-advancement.qmd:93 in the book's grant vocabulary, so the revel is earned or granted with no price attached; the book defines no coin, no inn tariff and no revel allowance, and the chapter's own titles sentence at :97 already models the granted-not-bought phrasing. CROSS-FILE, named: the repository's native-Typst gate 'check-native-typst.py' (named in f-006's evidence) counts opening fences and never tests for a closer, so it must gain a closing-fence check or this defect class re-enters; the fence fix must touch that file as well as the chapter. Out of scope by ruling: the zero-price reward phrasings at :80 and :97 (r-001 c1) and the chapter's arithmetic (r-001 c2). The award's magnitude stays open here and is carried under t-02 (r-001 c4).

Two defects stand (f-003, f-005; re-tested in round 2 by f-009 and not broken). MECHANICAL, chapter-local, with a bound to be printed: the carousing award at 18-advancement.qmd:93 may not ship as an automatic, uncapped point; the bound must be printed in the chapter - a DA-assigned value or a cap the text never authorises does not repair the defect (r-002 c3). Two defensible directions, both landing in 18-advancement.qmd:93: (a) recommended default, link the award to a level or level band; (b) cap the award per arc. No repair may rest on the claim that the points are irreversible, since the loss rule strips a whole band (r-002 c2), and any restated crossing figure must use night fourteen, not fifteen (r-002 c1). MECHANICAL, chapter-local: close the advertised title eligibility at 18-advancement.qmd:71 either by deleting the clause from the reputation opening or by printing the required standing inside the Earned Titles rule at :97; recommended default is deletion, because a standing gate on titles is a new rule with no implementer anywhere in the book (f-005, f-009). Do not map this ladder to the faction track at 19-gm-guidance.qmd:392-438 (r-002 c4).

Two defects stand (f-004, f-007; f-008's round-two challenge broke f-007's premise but reached neither defect). CROSS-CHAPTER MECHANICAL, two files: rename the level 3/6/9 gains-column label at 18-advancement.qmd:49,52,55 and the tally at :63 into the rank vocabulary the defining chapter and glossary use (08-disciplines.qmd:102-104, 21-glossary.qmd:87), and add the cross-reference to 08-disciplines.qmd, because the chapter's only existing pointer returns the reader to the same table (r-003 c1, c2); the identical rename must land in the milestone mirror at 22-reference-sheets.qmd:262,265,268. MECHANICAL, one line: the Archmage grant at 18-advancement.qmd:97 must state its tier's level requirement (Adept tier = level 3), because a granted card inherits its tier floor, and no waiver of that floor may be written in as part of this repair (r-003 c4). DESIGN QUESTION, left open by the ruling: whether the granted card is held outright (recommended default, matching its 4 DP value against the level-5 windfall row at :51) or lapses with the title must be worded explicitly and not assumed either way (r-003 c3). Any remedy that treats the reward section as unplayable or as needing redesign is rejected (r-003).
